message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right during dinner prep. After a brief moment of panic, I remembered I had charged up a power bank earlier in the week. I grabbed it, lit up the kitchen with a trusty lantern, and we ended up sharing laughs over sandwiches made by flashlight. It was a reminder that little wins—like keeping a few essentials charged—can turn a potential hassle into a cozy adventure. Have you ever made a small prep move that turned into a big win?
